# Going Deeper {.appendix #app-going-deeper}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

The exit map from learning lab to production: official SDKs and
LiteLLM, LlamaIndex and real vector stores, Pydantic AI and agent
frameworks, Pipecat and the voice stack, and Karpathy's Zero to Hero
for the reader who wants to build the model itself. Framed as a map,
not a manual: the ecosystem moves fast, the ideas you now have do
not.
:::
